method: Full reconciliation seal: unauthenticated public /markets/trades re-pulled for all 804 events (1608 legs), window-filtered to guarded [left,right], diffed by trade_id against prints.jsonl. Same method as the 21-game spot check. Verdict per game.

nightly_spotcheck_spec.method: Draw N=20 random Window-1 events (seeded by date), re-pull public /markets/trades for both legs over the guarded window, diff by trade_id vs prints.jsonl.
nightly_spotcheck_spec.alarm: Any of: ex_not_ours>0, ours_not_ex>0, price/size/side mismatch>0, or UNPULLABLE on a previously-pullable ticker. Page on first non-zero.
nightly_spotcheck_spec.escalation: On alarm, widen to full 804 reconciliation and freeze downstream ceiling artifacts until the diff is explained.
nightly_spotcheck_spec.rationale: Cheap standing guard against silent recorder drift or exchange-side restatement; the 21-of-21 and full-804 seals are the baseline it defends.
